prompt: A macOS document inspector was rebuilt from an approved design. Perform a screenshot review and layout check in the real native runtime at the minimum 620x520 window, the default 900x700 window, and a 1400x900 wide window. Check light and dark appearances, a long German localization, the empty-selection state, a document with the maximum metadata fields, and system text size increased one supported step. Verify toolbar/content hierarchy, sidebar alignment, field-label wrapping, truncation, minimum-window clipping, separator/material consistency, and whether resize transitions leave controls stranded or overlapping. The supplied reference is a default-size English light-mode capture, so do not treat it as a pixel oracle for other contexts; use Apple platform layout guidance and the established design tokens for those states.

requirements: the fixture runs a fixed macOS/Xcode build identity with deterministic document data
an approved default-size English light-mode reference capture is supplied
the app supports the three specified window sizes, light/dark appearance, localization fixture, and larger text setting
the runtime capture tool records window size, appearance, locale, and text-size context with each image

falsifiableChecks.assertion: The default English light-mode runtime is compared to the approved reference under matching size/content conditions, with observed spacing, alignment, typography, and material differences called out explicitly.

Minimum, wide, dark, long-localization, dense-content, empty-selection, and larger-text states have no unsupported clipping, overlap, stranded controls, or misleading truncation; failures are tied to exact captures.
Reference-pixel similarity is not used as the oracle for contexts absent from the reference; platform adaptation and established design-token claims are evaluated instead.

evidence: native adaptation is judged against platform and product intent rather than browser assumptions
the reference is not overextended to unsupported contexts
localization, density, text-size, and resize risks are represented

requiredEvidence: explicit unavailable or simulated evidence labels
